items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I did like Hardon, Bason and whatever that other one was.

ctx.x: That’s the short answer, my father. I remember when I was waitressing he said that it’s crème de manthe not crème de menthe — I said, “Daddy, that’s not the way the other waitresses pronounce it.” And he said, “And you should say langerie not lingerie. Why that came up I don’t remember. But nobody says langerie, an English speaker. And he was — he was an expert in the English language and that was the only subject I was ever good at in school, really. I was terrible at history, geography, chemistry. But I loved…
I did like Hardon, Bason and whatever that other one was.
That one, yeah. Well I found out that the word E-S-C-H-E-U apparently is pronounced “eschew.” I always thought it was askew. Like A-S-K —
